demo(model, graph) is appended identically to original.py and translated.ldpy (same pattern as JonasHeinickeBio__biomedical-knowledge-lookup__.../__add_concept_mappings already in this corpus): calls the extracted method and returns the graph it wrote into, not `self`, since comparing the stub instance itself would need an __eq__ -- added to RdfBaseModelStub (structural equality over its attribute dict) precisely so the driver's per-argument comparison doesn't report a spurious difference between the two sides' independently-constructed instances.
